slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report of aggregate counts from the October 2016 APAI-CRVS self-reported monitoring round; Uganda appears only in the annex's composite score bands (digitization 80-100%, legal framework 50-64%, infrastructure and resources 50-64%, planning and coordination 35-49%, registration process 35-49%, overall 50-64%), which state nothing about any one aspect and name no system.
